name: checker
what: A fresh agent's lens, with its exact prompt as a template.

fields.name: prompt
fields.means: the template; {record} is the record's path

trace.author: agent
trace.note: A checker's prompt changes only by an event that names it.
trace.reflection: Every new one is checked against the ones of its type that hold and says what it supersedes or merges; it is revised in place, each revision an event in the trace.
